notes.title: Update 2.0.3
notes.notes: [p]Before the big update, some small fixes:[/p][list][*][p]At Steam's request, the Patreon support link and button were removed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Since there was no FPS limiter system in the Login/Registration and Main Menu scenes, extremely high FPS values (1000–2000) were overheating players’ CPUs and GPUs. Because of this, some players claimed the game had a miner. No, there is no miner in the game—your GPU was simply working at maximum capacity to push unlimited FPS. This issue has now been completely resolved.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]The issue of the game starting in a small window has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]For some Xbox controller users, the problem of the screen automatically moving to the right seems to be fixed for now.[/p][/*][*][p]With small changes to the lightmap encoding system, minor graphical improvements were achieved.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Apewar Update 2.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello Apewar fans!

After a long break, I am happy to share the new update of Apewar!
With the Apewar 2.0.2 version, many bugs have been fixed, and small additions have been made. As you know, Apewar will be fully released this year. A time-consuming but worthwhile update is coming soon! New monkeys, tanks, military vehicles, new menu designs, new sounds, new game modes, new maps, and much more will be available with the full version of Apewar! I have been working on the full version update for about 15 months, carefully refining every detail to make everything perfect. So get your bananas ready because a massive update is waiting for you, Apewar fans!

1- Crashes in the login/registration systems have been fixed.
2- AI issues have been resolved.
3- The issue where the screen appeared black after creating a room has been fixed.
4- The IK problem in standard Kasakela and Kahama monkeys has been fixed.
5- The FPS drop issue caused by a physics problem in vehicles has been fixed.
6- A new optimization method applicable to all maps has been implemented.
7- Minor improvements and changes have been made to the UI/UX of the menus.

notes.title: Server Crashed
notes.notes:
Since our servers are like potatoes, it has crashed right now and we are trying to do everything we can to fix it. In addition, we need to do server maintenance in the new update that will come, we will solve these problems as soon as possible. We are sorry for the inconvenience we have caused you for our potato servers, but we will solve it immediately! 

As a temporary solution, you can click the "Play as a guest" button and continue playing without registering for the game. Our crashed server is only the section where players' registration information is located. So you just can't connect to your account, but you can play the game as a guest for fun.

I'm sorry to say that I broke a few systems in the 2.0 update due to a monkey mistake, so I have to postpone the new update for about 1 week. I am very sorry for this, I will try to release the update as fast as I can.

The monkey is sad, the monkey is ashamed ːsteamsadː

notes.title: Apewar 2.0 Update is Coming!
notes.notes:
[h3]APEWAR 2.0 Update[/h3]
[h3]Publication Date : 30.06.2023[/h3]

[b]Before the 2.0 Update is released, the game will be 20% off so you can invite your friends and have fun together![/b]

With Apewar 2.0, many innovations will come to the game and many problems will be solved. After a long-term work, we will give a nice update to our valuable monkey tribe friends.

[b]So what's new in Apewar 2.0?[/b]

Interface design improvements.
In-game friend addition system.
2nd Monkey War mode (WW2).
In-game badges that you can trade and sell on the Steam Marketplace.
Steam Achievements Exclusive to Apewar.
Weapon customization and special pattern packs for each weapon.
New monkey
Jumping track maps.
New sound effects for guns and monkeys.
Balanced product pricing.

[b]What updates will be coming until Apewar 3.0?[/b]

Weapon customization and special pattern packs for each weapon
Monkey costume system (Hats, glasses and clothes)
New monkeys
New tanks and vehicles.
Monkey special dances available in the game
Battle animations unique to each monkey.
More parkour maps
Arcade maps
New game modes (Infected monkeys, Domination, Gun race)

New monkeys, new maps, and many more features await you. You can now update our game and join the fun! We want to say that there may still be some errors in the game, including this update. We continue to fix these errors. We will never stop improving the game, and it will continue to evolve. Thank you for supporting us.

notes.title: Apewar Update v0.7
notes.notes:
We continue to improve our Ape War game. We have made new fixes in line with all of our players' requests. We have fixed the bugs. At the same time, we can say that this is a very big update! We are making such a big update for the first time. We invite you all to the war of the monkeys! OOOH AHHH!

[list]
[*] A Chinese server was added to the game specifically for Chinese players.
[*] Unreadable text due to font issues has been fixed.
[*] Chinese text displays have been corrected.
[*] Russian text displays have been corrected.
[*] Japanese text displays have been corrected.
[*] The Credits section has been updated.
[*] Issues caused by tank coding have been fixed.
[*] Tanks have been added back to the Forest map, but now there will only be 2 tanks on the map.
[*] Banana (health pack) and ammo boxes have been added to certain areas of the Forest map.
[*] Friendlyfire has been completely removed from the game.
[*] Bombs and grenade launchers no longer damage the player when they fire at themselves.
[*] The fixed camera problem after death has been resolved, and now players can watch the player who killed them for 5 seconds.
[*] In-game currency called BNNC (Banana Coin) has been added to the game.
[*] The damage of the APEBOMBER32 weapon has been reduced from 40 to 25, and the reload speed has been increased from 5.5 to 6.
[*] The damage of the APE7 weapon has been reduced from 90 to 60, the firing rate has been increased from 0.7 to 1, and the running and jumping speed has been decreased (it now fires more slowly and deals less damage).
[*] The sound of falling to the ground has been updated.
[*] A new explosion effect has been added to the tank's missile.
[*] The tank's health has been increased to 1000.
[*] The tank can now fire every 3 seconds.
[*] The tank's speed has been reduced by 15%.
[*] Gravity has been added to the tank missile, resulting in a more realistic tank missile effect.
[*] The issue of the sea disappearing when the game is set to low settings on the Ship map has been fixed.
[/list]

notes.notes:
[b]First of all[/b], we would like to thank you, our valuable players, who showed interest in our game. We really didn't expect this much attention. That's why we are trying to make our game even better against this love of yours.

notes.title: Apewar Update v0.3
notes.notes:
Our game continues to be updated throughout the early access period. We fixed most of the issues with the new update. We will continue.

[list]
[*]* The server capacity has been increased to the maximum level and the server error has been fixed.
[*]* Some changes have been made in the UI part.
[*]* The issue where the map was not appearing on the minimap in the Racetrack map has been fixed.
[*]* There was a problem where a wide reflection of the minimap on the ground was visible when getting into the car in the Racetrack map, and this has been fixed.
[*]* The transparency issue with the background in the Settings section of the Main Menu has been fixed.
[*]* An Announcements section has been added to the Main Menu.

notes.title: Hotfix Update: Bugs Fixed v0.2
notes.notes:
[u][b]Hotfix #1 v0.2[/b][/u]

When you log in to the game due to an error, you automatically connect to the Turkey server, so sometimes your connection could be disconnected and you could have trouble logging into the game. 
We fixed this issue and shared the new update.

You can have the lowest latency by selecting the closest server to your region from the Main Menu.

The appearance when entering the settings section in the main menu has been corrected.
